# Migrations

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the code. Do not edit: `pnpm test` fails when it is stale. -->

The steps of `db/schema.ts`, in order.

| Step | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1    | baseline. Brings a database from any earlier (unversioned) release up to date; the column additions are idempotent because old databases may already have some of them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 2    | runsForTask runs on every task view and every 500 ms per open log stream.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| 3    | repo integration. toolchain is detected at `repo add`; setup_cmd runs in each new worktree.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 4    | a repo can be paused (doctor failed, setup failed, permissions refused); runs count refused tool uses.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 5    | pull requests and task dependencies. pr_mode is off \| draft \| ready; pr_state is open \| merged \| closed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| 6    | task history. One row per status change, written with the change itself (db/tasks.ts).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 7    | plans attached to a task (domain/plan). One row per plan name; the HTML is parsed on read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| 8    | merging a PR from the app. merge_method is squash \| merge \| rebase: the repo's default, and the one a task was merged with.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| 9    | keeping task branches up to date with their base. A run is a work run or a resolve run (merging the base into the branch, which uses no attempt); auto_resolve lets the daemon start a resolve run on its own.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 10   | worker sandbox (docs/adr/0001-worker-sandbox.md). network is a JSON array of hosts sandboxed commands may reach.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| 11   | a task can name the plan and steps it carries out. plan_path is repo-relative under docs/plans/; plan_steps is a JSON array of step ids, NULL for every unfinished step.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 12   | archiving a repo. archived_at is when it was archived, NULL while it is active.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 13   | what a blocked worker said it needs: JSON { kind, items }, NULL when nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| 14   | who said a task is done: 'person' when mark_done set it, NULL otherwise.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 15   | the stop reason, named for the domain language.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 16   | a paused repo notifies with its own kind, `paused`, instead of `hold`. Whoever listened for `hold` keeps hearing both.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 17   | auto-merge. auto_merge_skip is a JSON array of path prefixes that need a person; a task's auto_merge is NULL (its repo's), 0 or 1.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 18   | task links. kind is builds_on \| after. after_task is copied in and no longer read.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 19   | the latest auto-merge check of a done task's open PR: JSON { verdict, reasons }, NULL when none; auto_merge_checked_at is when the PR refresh made it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 20   | reviews made in the dashboard. A review is a draft until submitted_at is set; kind is comment \| request_changes. A comment's state is open \| answered \| resolved; side is old \| new.                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| 21   | what a live run is doing: turns so far and the last tool call, kept from its stream while it runs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 22   | what the pilot scorecard needs and nothing kept. usage_samples is a history of usage readings, appended when a window's reading changes; pr_checks_opened / pr_checks_merged are JSON { total, failing, pending } of a PR's checks.                                                                                                                                                           |
| 23   | merge requests. merge_requested_at is when a person asked the daemon to merge the task's PR once it is ready (NULL: no request); merge_request_check is the last check's JSON { verdict, reasons }.                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 24   | plans live in AgentDeck, named after the task they belong to. plan_task is the task whose plan this one follows (itself when its own plan was given with --plan); plan_steps names that plan's steps. plan_path is no longer written.                                                                                                                                                         |
| 25   | when a run's pid was stored. Its claude started then, which can be minutes after the run row (setup, a sync), so crash recovery and the doctor tell our claude from a reused pid by this time, not by started_at.                                                                                                                                                                             |
| 26   | an open PR's latest checks, one by one (domain/landing/checks.ts StoredChecks): JSON { read_at, head, checks, notified }, written by the PR refresh; notified says a person was told they fail. NULL until the PR's checks are read.                                                                                                                                                          |
| 27   | when a sync of the task's branch began (NULL when none is running). Syncs run in the daemon only, so the CLI reads this to see one; the daemon clears every marker on start.                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| 28   | unblock runs (domain/runs/unblock.ts). auto_unblock lets the daemon start one on its own when a task blocks (off by default); question is the JSON { question, options } one left on a blocked task, cleared when the task is queued again.                                                                                                                                                   |
| 29   | the planner's last run is when the repo last had tasks proposed, so planned_at is now proposed_at.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| 30   | task_events as the outbox (domain/work/follow-ups.ts). follow_up_pending is 1 while a status change's follow-ups are still to run, and the daemon's tick runs them. Every row before this step, and every row older code writes, reads 0: their follow-ups ran inline, so they never run twice.                                                                                               |
| 31   | models. repos.model is the model a new task of the repo takes when it names none (NULL follows the default_model setting). runs.model is the model a run was started with and runs.model_id the exact id claude's init line named; both are NULL on rows from older code, which read as unknown.                                                                                              |
| 32   | review runs (domain/runs/review.ts). repos.auto_review lets the daemon start one when a task is done (off by default). reviews.by is who made a review (every earlier one was a person's); head_commit and diff_hash are the head and the patch-id of the changes it read, set at submit (NULL on older rows). runs.diff_hash is the diff a review run was started for, NULL for other kinds. |
| 33   | review_due, a new notification kind (domain/operations/review-due.ts), on by default. A stored notify_events does not take the setting's default, so the kind is added to it, unless a person turned every kind off.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| 34   | how a failed or blocked work run ended (domain/runs/translate/summary.ts's RunEnd) and whether its last test run failed, kept on the row because the log is not (a removed repo's logs are deleted). Older runs read as unknown.                                                                                                                                                              |
| 35   | escalation (domain/runs/escalate.ts). repos.escalate lets a retry after a failure a stronger model may fix run one model up (on by default); the change is an `escalate` row in task_events.                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| 36   | the base commit a verify run read (domain/runs/verify.ts), so its findings can be marked stale once the base moves on. NULL for every other kind.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| 37   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 38   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| 39   | repos.ci_not_run_ok (domain/landing/pull-request/ci-not-run.ts): a GitHub check that never started does not stop auto-merge when the last tested run passed (off by default).                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| 40   | tasks.park_reason, why a parked task (a proposal kept for later) waits; NULL in every other status.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 41   | tasks.target (domain/work/task/target.ts), the branch a task's work starts from and lands on; NULL is the repo's base.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 42   | plan_branches (domain/work/plans/plan-branch.ts), a branch a plan owns in a repo, one per (plan task, repo).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| 43   | plan_branches.synced_at, when the daemon last synced a plan branch with its base or tried to; NULL until then.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 44   | plan_branches.ahead_lines, the lines a plan branch is ahead of its base by as its last sync measured them; NULL until then.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| 45   | plan_branches' landing saga (domain/work/plans/landing-saga.ts): the plan's landing policy, the repo's place in an in_order plan, why the daemon's merge failed, and the commits a landing made, which a revert reads.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| 46   | plan_branches' plan review: its state, the head it read and the summary it left.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| 47   | repos' union_paths, a JSON array of path globs whose conflicts a sync's merge settles by keeping both sides' lines.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| 48   | repos' generated files: generated_paths, a JSON array of path globs, and generated_cmd, the command that rebuilds them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| 49   | repos' max_concurrent, how many of a repo's tasks may run at once under the daemon's max_concurrent.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
